title: 第17章 学狗叫第18章 进过监狱的都是垃圾
slug: 狂仙出狱第2234章龙主燃尽
content_zh:
此刻越来越多到场的宾客注意到了门口的动静，全都围过来看热闹。
他们看到洛千凝为一个衣着普通的年轻男子出头，都感到非常震惊。
就在众人纷纷揣测陈凡身份的时候，陈凡这时忽然提出了条件，竟然要让韩根硕当众学狗叫。
这一下，众人全都等着看热闹了。
韩家现在势力越来越大，平日里也是在花城作威作福，其实有很多人早就看他们不爽了。
现在，看到韩根硕吃瘪，不禁一个个幸灾乐祸。
“你说什么？让韩少学狗叫？你太过分了！”
方婷听到陈凡提出的要求，立刻就忍不了了。
“我不会让他喊我爷爷，这样的孙子，我可不要！
所以换成狗叫，有什么问题吗？”
陈凡理所当然地说道。
“你做梦！
韩少才不会答应你这种无理的要求！”
方婷说道。
啪！
李昭昭又是一耳光扇在的方婷脸上。
“记吃不记打是吗？这里没你说话的份！”
李昭昭冷声说道。
方婷从小到大就没受过这么多的委屈，这一刻的她气的牙都快咬碎了。
可，一想到洛千凝的身份，方婷实在不敢多说什么。

“韩少，君子一言驷马难追，刚才可是你提出的赌局，现在不会不算数吧？”
陈凡笑着说道。
韩根硕气的拳头紧握，身体忍不住都颤抖着。
奇耻大辱！
这绝对是奇耻大辱！
现在花城这么多有头有脸的人都在场，若是韩根硕真的当众学狗叫，那让他以后还有什么脸面在这里混下去？
“得饶人处且饶人，陈凡差不多就行了，让韩少给你道个歉，这件事就过去吧。”
人群中一名中年男子站了出来说道。
“我当是谁呢，原来是深蓝科技余总。”
陈凡道。
“没错，我是余伟，如果你愿意就此作罢，今后有需要帮忙的地方，尽管来找我！
content_en:
At this moment, more and more guests present noticed the movement at the door, and they all gathered around to watch the excitement.
They were all shocked when they saw Luo Qianning standing up for a young man in ordinary clothes.
Just when everyone was speculating on Chen Fan's identity, Chen Fan suddenly made a condition, asking Han Genshuo to bark like a dog in public.
This time, everyone was waiting to see the fun.
The Han family is becoming more and more powerful now, and they usually dominate the flower city. In fact, many people have long been unhappy with them.
Now, seeing Han Keun Suk's failure, everyone can't help but gloat over his misfortune.
"What are you talking about? You want Young Master Han to learn how to bark like a dog? You are going too far!"
When Fang Ting heard Chen Fan's request, she couldn't bear it immediately.
"I won't let him call me grandpa, I don't want such a grandson!
So if it’s a dog barking, what’s the problem? "
Chen Fan said matter-of-factly.
"You're dreaming!
Mr. Han will not agree to your unreasonable request! "
Fang Ting said.
Snap!
Li Zhaozhao slapped Fang Ting on the face again.
"Remember the food but not the fight, right? You have no place to speak here!"
Li Zhaozhao said coldly.
Fang Ting has never suffered so much grievance since she was a child. At this moment, she was so angry that her teeth were almost broken.
However, when she thought of Luo Qianning's identity, Fang Ting really didn't dare to say anything.
"Master Han, a gentleman's words are hard to follow. The bet you proposed just now won't count now, right?"
Chen Fan said with a smile.
Han Genshuo clenched his fists in anger, and his body couldn't help but tremble.
What a shame!
This is absolutely a shame!
Now that there are so many respectable people in Huacheng present, if Han Keunshuo really imitates howling like a dog in public, then what dignity will he have to hang around here in the future?
"You have to be merciful and merciful. Chen Fan will be alright. Let Mr. Han apologize to you and let this matter go."
A middle-aged man in the crowd stood up and said.
"Who did I think it was? It turns out to be President Yu of Deep Blue Technology."
Chen Fan said.
"Yes, I am Yu Wei. If you are willing to let it go, if you need help in the future, just come to me!
